about.contact.description: Contact line; keep the <mail></mail> tags around {email}

about.honor.defaultMessage: Anyone can post — we trust our neighbors. Entries that look like spam can be hidden by the site’s caretakers. If spam keeps showing up, we’ll add a neighborhood code or sign-in. Kids are welcome to help with a grown-up’s OK.
about.honor.description: Explains open posting and what happens if it is abused

about.how.fed.defaultMessage: Fed King? Tap “I fed King”, pick what he ate, and log it.

about.how.undo.defaultMessage: Made a mistake? You can undo for 10 minutes.

about.purpose.defaultMessage: This site helps us share the job: when he last ate, what he had, and where he was last seen — so nobody has to guess.

about.story.defaultMessage: King is an 11-year-old long-haired grey cat who did not make the move with his previous owner a few years ago, so the neighborhood decided to look after him together.
about.story.description: King’s story, first paragraph of the About page

privacy.intro.defaultMessage: We keep as little as possible.
privacy.intro.description: Opening line of the Privacy page

privacy.not.fonts.defaultMessage: Our fonts are hosted here, so visiting doesn’t contact Google.

privacy.not.ip.defaultMessage: Your internet address is used for about a minute to stop spam (it limits how often entries can be posted) and isn’t stored — except when someone signs in to the caretakers’ admin page, or tries to: then it’s kept with that sign-in and what they change there, for a year. We remove it from our technical logs.
privacy.not.ip.description: IP addresses: used briefly for rate limiting, stripped from telemetry; kept a year only in the admin activity log

privacy.not.maps.defaultMessage: Maps are the exception: the map pictures load from OpenStreetMap, which sees your internet address and which part of the map you’re looking at. See <policy>OpenStreetMap’s privacy policy</policy>.

privacy.not.title.description: Heading over the list of things not collected

privacy.not.tracking.defaultMessage: No accounts, ads, trackers or cookies.
privacy.not.tracking.description: Not collected: accounts, ads, trackers, cookies

privacy.parents.defaultMessage: For parents: kids can help without sharing anything about themselves. If they’d like a name on their entries, help them pick a nickname instead of their real name.
privacy.parents.description: Note for parents about children using the site

privacy.retention.defaultMessage: Entries are kept as King’s history, which everyone can see on the <history>history page</history>: every entry with its name, and a map of the places (never more exact than a block). Entries that look like spam can be hidden by the site’s caretakers. Want one removed? Email <mail>{email}</mail>.
privacy.retention.description: Retention, the public history page, and removal requests; keep the <history></history> tags around the link text and the <mail></mail> tags around {email}
